brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create exactly one finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, 1536x864 or larger. This is a brand-new illustration, not an edit.
Visual style: approved バスケまとめ style seen earlier: nearly black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B brush strokes, warm ivory text, bold hand-inked linework, expressive dry-brush hatching, limited elements, dramatic sports poster. Clearly drawn illustration, never photorealistic.
Reference roles: the earlier black/lime Culver thumbnail is STYLE ONLY: do not copy its person, pose, date, names or statistics. The official Mike Edwards portrait just viewed is LIKENESS REFERENCE ONLY: do not paste any photograph or reproduce any logos.
Subject: ONE real professional player, Mike Edwards (マイク・エドワーズ), based on official B.LEAGUE portrait https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/2487/2026-27/51000649_03.png and profile https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=51000649 . Preserve his distinctive shoulder-broad athletic frame, warm medium-light brown skin translated into warm ivory/charcoal ink tones, short black twisted braids hanging beside the ears, square front hairline, broad oval face, thick connected full dark beard and mustache, expressive eyebrows, broad nose, and recognizable facial proportions. No generic invented player. Plain dark sleeveless basketball kit with ivory trim; no logos, no sponsor text, no team words, no jersey number. Left arm may have a plain dark sleeve consistent with the reference.
Composition: NEW pose and layout, not the reference shooter's layout. Player occupies the LEFT 43%, face clearly visible in a three-quarter forward view, athletic low pivot with bent knees and torso leaning dynamically toward center, firmly holding an orange basketball in both hands near his waist in preparation for a pass. Frame from head through upper thighs, keep the complete head, both arms, both anatomically correct hands and complete ball visible, generous margins. Five natural fingers per hand, no extra limbs. A sweeping lime brush curve behind him suggests movement. The RIGHT 54% is calm negative space for enormous readable typography. No other players, no crowd, no scoreboard, no photographs. This is an editorial imagined pose, not a recreation of an actual game moment.
Text, render exactly, no additional words or numbers:
Small brand at top right: "バスケまとめ"
Date just beneath brand: "2026.11.08"
Main headline, very large ivory: "試合結果"
Second headline, very large lime: "当日のEFF"
Supporting line below headline, clear ivory: "B.ONE・B.NEXT｜ポジション別TOP3"
Smaller but fully readable status line: "19:08時点｜一部公式記録未確定"
Bottom footer on a calm dark strip, legible ivory: "イラスト（AI生成）　イメージ"
Use heavy Japanese Gothic type, carefully correct characters; choose sizing that fits every text line with at least 5% safe margin and no cropping. Do not overlap text with player, ball or hands. Visual hierarchy: headlines dominate, player face and motion second, scope and status clear but subordinate.
Editorial basis ONLY supplied fixed article: November 8 game results and daily official EFF position top-three for B.ONE and B.NEXT; some B.PREMIER game records are pending at 19:08 JST. Do not add scores or individual numbers. The selected player is RANDOM from the article's named players: do not include his name, performance, ranking, appearance claims, or imply he is the day's MVP. Do not write 成績をもとにしたイメージ. Use only the exact AI footer above. No team logos, league logos, watermarks, official photo pixels, UI elements, or extra lettering.
